title: Recolour the Meadow one piece per frame, on every sky change
context: On the Note10+, 10.17's "no frame over 100 ms" failed because MeadowLayers._apply redraws the mountains, every lake tile, every waterfall and every cloud (14-15 images) in one call, when the Meadow opens and on every later sky-colour change (clock about once a minute, the study time slider on every drag step). Confirmed by lab-emulator probes: a 46-137 ms raster burst per recolour; removing most of it brought page and study longest frames to 59-92 ms.
options: Pace every recolour, pieces switching one at a time
Pace every recolour, all pieces switching together when ready
outcome: The owner chose to pace every recolour with pieces switching one at a time (one piece per frame, order mountains, lake tiles, waterfalls, clouds, newest palette each), bounded: the lake is always redrawn straight after the mountains, every piece shows the newest colour within one frame per piece plus one (15 frames for the bench meadow), and the Meadow never opens half-coloured. The owner accepted that a lake tile's faint reflection may take up to about 22 frames when a change lands mid-lake. Spec: docs/specs/meadow-opening-recolour-stutter.md.
